description: Scrape employee reviews from Glassdoor companies by URL, name, or employer id. No login, cookie, or proxy setup is required.

companies.description: Glassdoor company Review or Overview URLs, company names, or employer ids. Add one item per company. Example: https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/Google-Reviews-E9079.htm or Google or 9079.
companies.title: Companies

employmentType.description: Only keep reviews with this employment status.
employmentType.title: Employment type

includeCompanyProfile.description: Add company profile fields such as website, headquarters, size, revenue, industry, CEO, and company sub-ratings to each review. This makes one extra request per company.
includeCompanyProfile.sectionDescription: Optional company context. Leave this off for the smallest and fastest run.
includeCompanyProfile.title: Include company profile

includeWorldwideReviews.description: Remove Glassdoor's default review criteria and include reviews from all countries. This raises the review ceiling but can add much older or non-local reviews.
includeWorldwideReviews.title: Include worldwide reviews

jobFunction.description: Only keep reviews whose job function matches this category.
jobFunction.title: Job function

jobTitleKeywords.description: Only keep reviews whose job title matches these words. Glassdoor may also return closely related titles, such as software developer for software engineer.
jobTitleKeywords.title: Job title keywords

keyword.description: Only keep reviews that mention this word or phrase.
keyword.title: Review text keyword

language.description: Language of the reviews to collect. Choose all languages to include every language Glassdoor exposes.
language.title: Review language

location.description: City, state, metro area, or country to filter reviews by, such as New York, NY or London. Leave empty for all locations. The value is resolved automatically through Glassdoor's location search.
location.title: Location

maxItems.description: Maximum number of reviews to save across all companies.
maxItems.title: Maximum reviews

maxReviewsPerCompany.description: Maximum reviews to save for each company. Set to 0 for no per-company limit.
maxReviewsPerCompany.title: Maximum reviews per company

onlyCurrentEmployees.description: Only keep reviews written by current employees.
onlyCurrentEmployees.title: Current employees only

onlyWithEmployerResponses.description: Only keep reviews that have an official employer response.
onlyWithEmployerResponses.title: Only reviews with employer responses

postedWithinDays.description: Only keep reviews posted within this many days. Uses newest-first order and stops when older reviews are reached.
postedWithinDays.title: Posted within

rating.description: Only keep reviews with this exact overall star rating.
rating.title: Star rating

sortBy.description: Order in which Glassdoor returns reviews.
sortBy.sectionDescription: Optional filters for the review export. When a date window is selected, sorting is forced to newest first.
sortBy.title: Sort reviews by

title: Glassdoor Employee Review Export Input
